reason: The posted daily cleaning log and shoes-off, limited-capacity rules are exactly what I check for before the kids touch anything, and the free first visit lets me see it for myself. I'd come once free and maybe once more on a weekday if it really is clean.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, and $13 a kid plus a sibling every visit is a lot on our budget. I'd also want to see that the cleaning is real and not just a sign on the wall.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the cleaning log and the place actually spotless on the free visit, and a cheaper way to go, like a sibling deal or a pack, that makes the drive worth it.
